endpoint.description:
Blocked with `CLINICAL_LOCKOUT` ("Patient ticket has been refunded. Cannot add clinical data
without an active billing slip.") or `TICKET_NOT_ACTIVE` for refunded/void/expired tickets.

A bedside procedure (MSDS IMS 150) is a note of type `Procedure` (on the visit or the admission) with `procedure`:
who did what, where, under which anaesthesia and consent, the findings, the specimens, the complications and the
patient's condition at the end. It is signed (finalize) only with the findings, the specimens ('None' if nothing was
removed) and the condition at the end: `PROCEDURE_NOTE_INCOMPLETE` with details.missing otherwise.

`examination_consent` records the patient's permission before the physical examination (VerbalObtained prints as
"VCO"); ask it, never pre-fill it. Under the Clinic profile an OPD or follow-up note is finalized only with it
(`EXAMINATION_CONSENT_REQUIRED`) and with the complaint or history, the findings when examined, a diagnosis and the
plan (`CONSULTATION_INCOMPLETE`, also with `finalize: true`); Declined and NotExamined leave the examination empty
(`VALIDATION_ERROR`).

Always send an `Idempotency-Key` (one per note, the same on a retry): a retry after a lost answer then returns the
first note instead of writing a second one into the patient's record.
An id in the request body that does not exist: `REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND` (details.field).
`ICD_CODE_UNKNOWN`: a code is not in the active ICD code list: pick it from the ICD picker.

`TICKET_PATIENT_MISMATCH`: the ticket is another patient's than `patient_id`: check who the patient is.

endpoint.summary: Verify (publish + notify doctor) or reject back to the bench
endpoint.description:
After a lost answer, never repeat the decision by itself: read `GET /lab/requisitions/{requisition_id}` (the
queue row's `requisition_id`) and find this `result_id` in its `results`. `Published` (with `verified_stamp`) or
`Rejected`: decided; still `PendingVerification`: not decided, offer it again.
Verified publishes the result: `lab.result.published` goes to the ordering doctor and the verifiers; a lab-only
walk-in has no ordering doctor, so it goes to the reception desk that registers walk-ins (the users holding both
`patient.create` and `lab.requisition.create`), who hand its report over.
The technician who entered a result cannot verify it (`LAB_VERIFIER_MUST_DIFFER`). Verifying a critical result
(`has_critical_value`) opens it in the critical results log (`GET /critical-results`): tell the doctor now and
record it there (MSDS AAC 5). `delay_reason`: why a late result was late (MSDS AAC 4). A result already verified or
rejected: `LAB_RESULT_STATE_INVALID`.

**Required permission:** `lab.result.verify`

Stored in the protected patient vault; only its path and SHA-256 are in the database. Documents are PDF, JPEG or
PNG (a scan or a photo of the paper); `doc_type=Photo`, the Patient Photo, is a JPEG or PNG only, at most 16

require it (an emergency, facial injuries, a patient who cannot cooperate or declines it: purdah, privacy). The
newest one is `photo_document_id` on the patient and on the admission.

Reports, tests and prescriptions the patient brings from elsewhere: `is_outside=true` with `source_facility`, the
date on the paper (`document_date`) and a `title` naming the test or report; `doc_type` `LabReport`, `Imaging`,

results of this hospital's laboratory or imaging.

`UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE`: another file type, a PDF as the Photo, or content that is not the type the file claims;
`VALIDATION_ERROR`: a damaged or oversized image, an outside document without its facility, a Photo marked outside,
a date in the future; `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` above MAX_UPLOAD_MB; `NOT_FOUND`: no such patient.

endpoint.summary: Link the PACS study (auto-find by accession if no ids given)
endpoint.description:
Links the study the modality sent to the hospital's PACS (Orthanc). With `{}` the server finds it by the order's
`accession_number`. A radiographer who copied the study's Orthanc id from the PACS (the modality was given no or a
wrong accession number) sends `orthanc_study_id`: the server asks the PACS for that study and takes its
`study_instance_uid` from there, never from the request. An examination in progress becomes Completed; an order
never started keeps its status until the radiographer records the checks before the examination. The worker also
links studies by accession number every two minutes, so a study that has not arrived yet links itself later.

`PACS_NOT_CONFIGURED`: this server has no PACS (IT has not set `ORTHANC_ENABLED`, the default): nothing is linked,
the order is unchanged, and retrying never helps; complete the examination with `POST /imaging/orders/{order_id}/
status` (`Completed`), and the report works without images. `ORTHANC_UNAVAILABLE` (retryable): the PACS did not
answer; the order is unchanged. `IMAGING_STUDY_NOT_FOUND`: the PACS has no study with this accession number yet
(`details.accession_number`) or no study with this `orthanc_study_id`: nothing is linked. `IMAGING_ORDER_STATE_INVALID`:
the order is cancelled. `NOT_FOUND`: no such order.

data.form_title: داخلے اور علاج کے لیے عمومی رضامندی
data.form_body:
میں اس ہسپتال میں داخل ہونے اور اپنے ڈاکٹروں کی تجویز کردہ ضروری معائنوں، ٹیسٹوں، نرسنگ نگہداشت اور علاج پر رضامند ہوں۔ کوئی آپریشن، بے ہوشی، خون لگانا یا کوئی اور خطرے والا طبی عمل مجھے الگ سے سمجھایا جائے گا اور میری الگ رضامندی کے بغیر نہیں کیا جائے گا۔
میرے داخلے کی ضرورت، اندازاً قیام کی مدت اور خرچ، جو نیچے درج ہیں، مجھے سمجھا دیے گئے ہیں۔ میں سمجھتا/سمجھتی ہوں کہ یہ اندازے ہیں جو میری حالت …
